request.prompt_head:
The person asks:
When does my residence permit expire?

response.text:
Your residence permit expires on Mon 30 Nov 2026 [item:itm_p0k64jp7r8bf]. Ordnung marks it "renew soon".

- If you apply before it expires, the permit usually counts as still valid until the office decides. Ask for a Fiktionsbescheinigung. This is not the case for a Schengen visa [item:itm_p0k64jp7r8bf].
- Your passport expires on Wed 10 Feb 2027 [item:itm_cw9j6w5ppdvs]. Ordnung says this date needs checking. A residence permit usually runs only as long as the passport, so check the passport date against the letter.
